breakdown.title: How this score is calculated
breakdown.description: Each risk category contributes a deterministic penalty proportional to the share of items affected. Nothing is sent off your device.
breakdown.noFindings: No risks contribute to your score.

weak.label: Weak passwords
weak.whyMatters: Weak passwords can be guessed or brute-forced quickly.
weak.whatToDo: Replace each weak password with a long, randomly generated one.

reused.label: Reused passwords
reused.whyMatters: Reusing a password lets one breach unlock multiple accounts.
reused.whatToDo: Generate a unique password for every reused account.

old.label: Old passwords
old.whyMatters: Older passwords are more likely to have leaked since they were created.
old.whatToDo: Rotate passwords that have not changed in 90+ days, especially for sensitive accounts.

breached.label: Known breaches
breached.whyMatters: Breached passwords are already published in attacker wordlists.
breached.whatToDo: Change every breached password before doing anything else.

missing2fa.label: Missing 2FA
missing2fa.whyMatters: Two-factor authentication blocks most attacks that reuse leaked passwords.
missing2fa.whatToDo: Enable TOTP on each login that supports it and store the secret here.

missing2faDesc: Login items without a stored TOTP secret
missing2faInfo: Login items that could be protected with a TOTP authenticator
missing2faDetail: Add a TOTP secret for this login

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.kAnonymity: Only the first 5 characters of the SHA-1 hash are sent. The full hash and plaintext password never leave your device.
privacy.source: Source: Have I Been Pwned (k-anonymity range API)
